Read only the section needed for the current UDT.

Replace the container placeholder with a pinned BioContainer found through one
bounded live BioContainers lookup. Use a bare tagged reference without
`docker://` or a digest.

```yaml

id: analysis-v1
name: Analysis
version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  selected-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:

    type: data
```

representation.shell_command:
set -eu
python - "$(inputs.input.path)" <<'PY'
import csv
import math
import sys

input_path = sys.argv[1]
required = {"rowname", "log2FoldChange", "padj"}
seen = set()
background = []
foreground = []

with open(input_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
    reader = csv.DictReader(handle, delimiter="\t")
    if reader.fieldnames is None or not required.issubset(set(reader.fieldnames)):
        raise SystemExit("Input must contain rowname, log2FoldChange, and padj columns")
    for row_number, row in enumerate(reader, start=2):
        gene_id = (row.get("rowname") or "").strip()
        if not gene_id:
            raise SystemExit("Blank gene identifier at input row %d" % row_number)
        if gene_id in seen:
            raise SystemExit("Duplicate gene identifier: %s" % gene_id)
        seen.add(gene_id)
        background.append(gene_id)
        try:
            lfc = float(row["log2FoldChange"])
            padj = float(row["padj"])
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            continue
        if math.isfinite(lfc) and math.isfinite(padj) and lfc > 0 and abs(lfc) >= 1.5 and padj <= 0.05:
            foreground.append(gene_id)

with open("foreground.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
    handle.write("gene_id\n")
    handle.write("\n".join(foreground))
    handle.write("\n")

with open("background.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
    handle.write("gene_id\n")
    handle.write("\n".join(background))
    handle.write("\n")
PY

representation.name: Prefix PA14 genes with KEGG organism code
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
python - "$(inputs.foreground.path)" "$(inputs.background.path)" <<'PY'
import csv
import sys

def convert(input_path, output_path):
    with open(input_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
        reader = csv.DictReader(handle, delimiter="\t")
        if reader.fieldnames is None or "gene_id" not in reader.fieldnames:
            raise SystemExit("Expected a gene_id column")
        values = []
        for row in reader:
            gene_id = (row.get("gene_id") or "").strip()
            if not gene_id:
                raise SystemExit("Blank gene identifier")
            if not gene_id.startswith("paf:"):
                gene_id = "paf:" + gene_id
            values.append(gene_id)
    with open(output_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
        handle.write("gene_id\n")
        handle.write("\n".join(values))
        handle.write("\n")

convert(sys.argv[1], "foreground_paf.tsv")
convert(sys.argv[2], "background_paf.tsv")
PY

representation.shell_command:
set -eu
test -r "$(inputs.anchor.path)"
python - <<'PY'
from urllib.error import HTTPError, URLError
from urllib.request import urlopen

codes = ["pae","paf","pag","pah","pai","paj","pak","pal","pam","pan","pao","pap","paq","par","pas","pat","pau","pav","paw","pax","pay","paz"]
with open("pseudomonas_code_scan.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8") as out:
    out.write("code\tmapping_rows\tPA14_hits\tfirst_mapping\n")
    for code in codes:
        try:
            text = urlopen("https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/" + code, timeout=20).read().decode("utf-8")
            rows = [line for line in text.splitlines() if line]
            hits = [line for line in rows if "PA14_" in line]
            first = rows[0] if rows else ""
            out.write("%s\t%d\t%d\t%s\n" % (code, len(rows), len(hits), first))
        except (HTTPError, URLError, TimeoutError) as exc:
            out.write("%s\tERROR\tERROR\t%s\n" % (code, type(exc).__name__))
PY
